title: The Race To A Billion AI Users
source: ChatGPT figures are OpenAI-reported weekly active users; Gemini figures are Google-reported monthly active users — different cadences, same order of magnitude, both from each company's own disclosures as reported by Reuters, TechCrunch and Android Headlines (2021-2026). Figures approximate, especially 2022-2024 which are estimated from public growth milestones.
